products.name: New Home Construction and Sales
products.description: Designs, builds, and sells new homes—including detached and attached single-family homes, townhomes, and condominiums—primarily for first-time, move-up, and active adult buyers. Homes are constructed in development communities, urban in-fill locations, and mixed-use projects, with buyers able to personalize floor plans and features through the Built to Order® process and KB Home Design Studios. Delivery requires land acquisition, physical construction, and compliance with local regulations.

products.name: Mortgage Banking Services
products.description: Provides residential consumer mortgage loan originations to homebuyers, primarily through KBHS Home Loans, LLC, an unconsolidated joint venture. Services are offered as part of the home purchase process and require financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Title Services
products.description: Offers title services to homebuyers in certain markets as part of the home purchase transaction. These services facilitate the legal transfer of property ownership and require specialized personnel and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Homebuyer Insurance Products
products.description: Offers various insurance products to homebuyers in the markets where homes are sold. These products are provided through the company's financial services operations and require regulatory compliance and partnerships with insurance providers.

products.name: Adult Entertainment Nightclubs
products.description: Operation of adult entertainment nightclubs under various brands, offering live adult entertainment, alcoholic beverages, food, and merchandise. These venues require physical locations, regulated infrastructure, and in-person human labor.

products.name: Bombshells Restaurant and Bar
products.description: Operation of Bombshells, a military-themed restaurant and bar concept featuring food, alcoholic beverages, entertainment, and sports viewing. Requires physical restaurant locations, in-person staff, and regulated food and alcohol service.

products.name: Industry Media and Events Services
products.description: Provision of business communications, trade publications, conventions, award shows, and digital media services for the adult nightclub and adult retail products industries. Delivered through print, digital, and in-person events.

products.name: Energy Drink Sales
products.description: Sales of Robust Energy Drink in the United States through licensing and distribution. Involves physical product manufacturing and distribution.

products.name: Personal Lines Insurance
products.description: Comprehensive property and casualty insurance policies for individuals, including homeowners, dwelling fire, cooperative/condominium, renters, and personal umbrella coverage. These are underwritten and serviced by the company, requiring regulated insurance operations, risk assessment, and claims management.

products.name: Livery Physical Damage Insurance
products.description: Insurance policies covering only the physical damage portion for for-hire vehicles such as livery, car service vehicles, and taxicabs. These are specialized auto insurance products, underwritten and managed by the company, and do not include liability coverage.

products.name: Specialty and Other Insurance
products.description: Niche insurance products including canine legal liability policies and participation in mandatory state joint underwriting associations. These are minor, specialized offerings managed by the company as part of its regulated insurance operations.

products.name: Home Solar Energy Systems (Leased and Power Purchase Agreements)
products.description: Ownership and operation of residential rooftop solar energy systems, delivered to homeowners through long-term lease and power purchase agreements (PPAs) with recurring monthly payments. Systems are physically installed and maintained on customer premises, requiring capital investment, ongoing maintenance, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Solar Renewable Energy Credits (SRECs) Sales
products.description: Sale of solar renewable energy credits generated by owned home solar energy systems to third parties under contracted prices. This involves monetizing the environmental attributes of solar generation, typically through regulated markets or bilateral contracts.

products.name: Solar Portfolio Managed Services (Spruce Pro Platform)
products.description: Provision of portfolio management and servicing for third-party owned solar energy systems, including billing, collections, account support, financial asset management, homeowner support, asset operations, and SREC transaction services. Delivered via the Spruce Pro digital servicing platform, covering residential, commercial, and industrial assets.

products.name: Master Lease Interest Income
products.description: Earning interest income and cash flows from customer contracts related to master lease agreements for home solar energy systems. This is a financial product involving the acquisition of rights to payment streams from existing solar contracts.

products.name: LED Lighting Systems and Fixtures
products.description: Manufactured and sourced LED lighting fixtures and systems, including high bay fixtures, troffer retrofits, and smart lighting controls, for interior and exterior commercial and industrial applications. Products are produced at the company's facility and through third-party sourcing, and delivered via direct sales, distributors, and ESCOs.

products.name: Lighting and Electrical Maintenance Services
products.description: Preventative and reactive maintenance, repair, and replacement services for lighting and related electrical components in commercial and industrial facilities, delivered through service contracts and on-demand work orders.

products.name: Turnkey Lighting Installation and Energy Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive project-based services including site assessment, engineering design, project management, installation, commissioning, and recycling for lighting retrofit and energy management systems, delivered through direct engagement or via partners.

products.name: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Infrastructure Solutions
products.description: Turnkey solutions for commercial and industrial EV charging infrastructure, including site audit, engineering, installation, commissioning, network services, and ongoing support, with all charging stations and components sourced from third parties.

products.name: Other Specialty LED Fixtures and Private Label Products
products.description: A variety of specialty LED fixtures designed for specific applications such as agribusiness, parking lots, mezzanine, outdoor use, and private label resale, manufactured or sourced to address unique customer needs.

products.name: Human Capital Management (HCM) Software Platform
products.description: A cloud-based SaaS platform providing integrated payroll, HR management, time & attendance, recruiting, and benefits administration tools, primarily for small and mid-sized employers. Delivered digitally and accessed via web and mobile interfaces.

products.name: Payroll Processing and Compliance Services
products.description: Comprehensive payroll calculation, processing, and administration services, including wage calculations, direct deposit, garnishments, and payroll tax filing and remittance across federal, state, and local jurisdictions. Delivered via SaaS platform and managed services.

products.name: HR Compliance and Workforce Management Services
products.description: Digital and advisory services for HR compliance, workforce planning, performance management, and regulatory support, delivered through tiered service offerings and digital resource libraries.

products.name: Time and Attendance Solutions
products.description: Software and hardware solutions for tracking employee work hours, labor scheduling, and attendance, including mobile, biometric, and geo-positioning technologies. Delivered as SaaS and through time clock hardware (sold or via Hardware-as-a-Service).

products.name: Talent Acquisition and Recruiting Solutions
products.description: Applicant tracking and recruiting tools supporting job posting, applicant management, interview scheduling, and hiring workflows, integrated with third-party job boards and delivered digitally.

products.name: Benefits and Retirement Administration Services
products.description: Insurance brokerage and administration services for employer-sponsored health and retirement plans, including eligibility tracking, ACA and COBRA compliance, and 401(k) plan administration. Integrated with payroll and delivered via SaaS and licensed brokerage.

products.name: Employee Financial and Payment Services
products.description: Payroll debit card programs and earned wage access solutions, enabling electronic payment distribution to employees, integrated with payroll processing and delivered in partnership with financial institutions.

products.name: Enterprise Payroll Tax and Treasury Solutions
products.description: Software platforms and outsourced services for payroll tax calculation, filing, remittance, and treasury management, designed for payroll service bureaus, large employers, and systems integrators. Delivered as SaaS and managed services.

products.name: Platform Integrations and Marketplace Services
products.description: Pre-built integrations and marketplace services enabling data exchange and interoperability between Asure’s HCM platform and third-party applications, generating transactional, referral, or service-related fees.

products.name: Automated Metrology Systems
products.description: High-performance systems for optical critical dimension (OCD), thin film, and wafer stress metrology, primarily used in semiconductor front-end manufacturing. These systems require precision optics, advanced modeling software, and are physically manufactured and installed at customer sites.

products.name: Integrated Metrology Systems
products.description: Metrology systems installed directly onto wafer processing equipment to provide near real-time measurements for process control and throughput optimization in semiconductor manufacturing. These are hardware systems integrated with customer tools.

products.name: Silicon Wafer All-surface Inspection and Characterization Systems
products.description: Inspection and characterization tools for frontside, edge, and backside of silicon wafers, including contamination monitoring, defect detection, and materials analysis. These systems use advanced optics and sensors and are physically manufactured and installed at customer sites.

products.name: Macro Defect Inspection Systems
products.description: Automated inspection tools for detecting and classifying macro defects on wafers and advanced packaging substrates throughout semiconductor manufacturing. These systems use high-speed imaging and proprietary software for defect analysis.

products.name: Opaque Film Metrology Systems
products.description: Non-contact systems for measuring thickness and properties of metal and non-metallic opaque film layers in semiconductor devices, using laser-based acoustic wave technology. These are physically manufactured tools used in both front-end and back-end fabs.

products.name: Advanced Packaging Lithography Systems
products.description: Lithography steppers and systems designed for advanced packaging applications, including wafer and panel-level substrates, enabling high-resolution patterning for redistribution layers and 3D/heterogeneous integration. These are complex optical systems physically manufactured and installed at customer sites.

products.name: Process Control Software
products.description: Advanced software solutions for process control in semiconductor manufacturing, including run-to-run control, fault detection, classification, and tool automation. Delivered as digital software, often integrated with hardware systems or deployed factory-wide.

products.name: Yield Management Software
products.description: Software platforms for analyzing and managing yield and productivity data from semiconductor manufacturing, integrating data from inspection, metrology, and other sources to support process optimization. Delivered as digital software, often deployed enterprise-wide.

products.name: Industrial and Scientific Interferometry Systems
products.description: Interferometry systems for high-precision measurement and inspection of optical surfaces, aerospace and defense components, and scientific instrumentation. These are specialized physical instruments sold to industrial and research customers.

products.name: XDEMVY (lotilaner ophthalmic solution) 0.25%
products.description: A prescription topical eye drop formulated with lotilaner, manufactured via aseptic compounding and filling, for the treatment of Demodex blepharitis. Delivered through specialty sales force and commercial distribution channels, requiring FDA approval and cGMP-compliant manufacturing.

products.name: TP-04 (lotilaner topical sterile ophthalmic gel)
products.description: An investigational sterile aqueous gel formulation of lotilaner, produced for topical ophthalmic application, under clinical development for the treatment of ocular rosacea. Manufactured using contract manufacturing organizations for clinical trials, with plans for commercial distribution upon approval.

products.name: TP-05 (lotilaner oral tablet)
products.description: An investigational oral tablet formulation of lotilaner, developed as a systemic prophylactic for Lyme disease and potentially for community malaria reduction. Manufactured by contract organizations for clinical trials, intended for oral administration to provide systemic protection against tick-borne diseases.

products.name: Quantum Computing Systems (On-Premises)
products.description: Fully integrated superconducting quantum computers, including quantum processing units (QPUs), control systems, and supporting infrastructure, delivered and installed at customer sites for direct operation and research. These systems are physically manufactured, assembled, and require specialized installation and support.

products.name: Quantum Processing Units (QPUs)
products.description: Standalone superconducting quantum processor chips, such as the Novera QPU, sold to customers for integration into their own quantum computing research or systems. These are manufactured hardware components produced in-house at the company's fabrication facility.

products.name: Quantum Computing as a Service (QCaaS)
products.description: Cloud-based access to Rigetti’s quantum computers, allowing customers to run quantum algorithms and applications remotely via the internet. This service is delivered digitally through proprietary and partner cloud platforms, requiring no physical hardware installation for the customer.

products.name: Rigetti Quantum Cloud Services (QCS) Platform
products.description: A proprietary cloud platform providing hybrid quantum-classical computing environments, software development tools, and integration with public/private clouds. Delivered digitally, it enables users to access, program, and manage quantum computing resources remotely.

products.name: Foundry Services (Superconducting Quantum Chips)
products.description: Custom fabrication and delivery of superconducting quantum chips for external customers, including academic and government research labs. These chips are physically manufactured at the company’s in-house wafer fabrication facility (Fab-1).

products.name: Professional Services (Quantum Consulting & Development)
products.description: Fee-based consulting and engineering services to help customers with quantum algorithm development, benchmarking, application programming, and software development. Delivered through in-person or remote expert human labor.

products.name: IT Integration Solutions and Value-Added Resale (VAR) Services
products.description: Comprehensive IT solutions including the resale of third-party hardware and software, combined with planning, design, implementation, and optimization services. Delivered through direct sales and technical consulting, primarily to SMB and enterprise customers across various industries.

products.name: Professional IT Consulting Services
products.description: Consulting services for IT assessments, planning, design, implementation, migration, optimization, project management, and compliance. Delivered by in-person technical experts and project managers, often bundled with hardware/software sales.

products.name: Managed IT and Cloud Services
products.description: Ongoing managed services including proactive monitoring, remote management, managed security, backup, unified communications, and cloud services (e.g., Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud). Delivered via remote operations centers and cloud platforms, with monthly billing options.

products.name: Cybersecurity Software Solutions (ARIA Portfolio)
products.description: Proprietary software-defined security platform (ARIA SDS, ADR, AZT PROTECT) for network security, threat detection, and response. Delivered as licensed software, support packages, and services, targeting regulated industries and critical infrastructure.

products.name: Network Adapters and Related Software (Myricom)
products.description: High-performance network interface cards (SmartNICs) and related software for applications requiring high bandwidth and low latency, such as packet capture, financial transactions, and machine vision. Delivered as physical hardware and supporting software.

products.name: Legacy Multicomputer Products for DSP Applications
products.description: Specialized multicomputer hardware for digital signal processing (DSP) applications, primarily for defense markets. Products are no longer actively developed but continue to be sold and supported for existing programs.

products.name: INTRUSION Shield
products.description: A Zero Trust, reputation-based Software as a Service (SaaS) cybersecurity platform that inspects and blocks dangerous network connections using proprietary threat intelligence. Delivered as on-premise hardware, cloud gateway, and endpoint software for comprehensive network protection.

products.name: INTRUSION TraceCop
products.description: A big data tool and database providing extensive IP intelligence, historical internet data, and network forensics capabilities for cybersecurity analysis. Delivered as a software solution for forensic investigations and threat analysis.

products.name: INTRUSION Savant
products.description: A network monitoring and attack analysis tool that leverages TraceCop data to identify suspicious traffic in real-time, used by forensic analysts and threat research teams. Delivered as a software solution for network reconnaissance and automated rule-based packet inspection.

products.name: Customer Support and Maintenance Services
products.description: Technical support, installation, repair, and extended warranty services for the company's cybersecurity solutions, provided both on-site and remotely. Delivered as service contracts or time-and-materials support to end customers.

products.name: Luxury Skiwear
products.description: High-performance, fashion-forward ski apparel for women, men, and children, manufactured using technical fabrics and bold designs, distributed through direct-to-consumer and wholesale channels.

products.name: Luxury Outerwear
products.description: Premium outerwear designed for both alpine and urban environments, blending technical performance with elevated aesthetics, produced with high-quality materials and distributed globally.

products.name: Lifestyle Apparel
products.description: Fashion-led lifestyle clothing including loungewear and multi-seasonal collections, less technical but premium, designed for everyday wear and manufactured with a focus on style and comfort.

products.name: Activewear
products.description: Technical and stylish activewear for athletic and leisure pursuits, produced with performance fabrics and designed for year-round use, distributed through digital and retail channels.

products.name: Swimwear and Surfwear
products.description: Fashionable and functional swimwear and surfwear inspired by summer and surf culture, manufactured with technical materials for performance and style, targeting both leisure and sport consumers.

products.name: Accessories
products.description: Premium accessories such as knitwear and other complementary items, designed to enhance the brand experience and produced in partnership with expert vendors for both alpine and urban use.

products.name: Water Pumping Systems
products.description: Integrated systems including submersible motors, pumps, drives, electronic controls, monitoring devices, and related parts for moving fresh and wastewater in residential, agricultural, municipal, and industrial applications. These are physically manufactured and distributed globally.

products.name: Water Treatment Systems
products.description: Manufactured systems and equipment for treating water, including filtration and purification, sold primarily to residential, commercial, and industrial customers. Delivered as physical products through direct and third-party distribution.

products.name: Submersible Pumps for Mining and Industrial Applications
products.description: Specialized submersible pumps designed and manufactured for mining, industrial, and commercial sectors, including dewatering and high-durability applications. Delivered as physical equipment.

products.name: Fuel Pumping and Containment Systems
products.description: Manufactured systems including pumps, motors, piping, sumps, vapor recovery, electronic controls, and monitoring devices for fuel transfer, storage, and containment at gas stations and other energy infrastructure. Delivered as physical equipment with installation and certification support.

products.name: Power Reliability and Monitoring Systems
products.description: Intelligent electronic devices and systems for online monitoring and reliability of power utility, hydroelectric, rail, telecommunication, and data center infrastructure. Delivered as manufactured hardware and digital monitoring solutions.

products.name: Groundwater Equipment Distribution
products.description: Distribution of water well and groundwater equipment, including pumps, motors, controls, and related products, primarily to professional contractors in the U.S. Delivered through a network of wholly owned distribution companies.

products.name: Custom Upholstered Furniture
products.description: Manufactured in company-owned factories in North Carolina, this line includes both stationary and motion upholstered furniture for indoor use, produced to customer specifications and delivered through retail stores and wholesale channels.

products.name: Leather Upholstered Furniture
products.description: Includes leather sofas, chairs, and other seating, sourced both domestically and internationally, and sold through retail and wholesale channels. Production involves both in-house manufacturing and sourcing from foreign suppliers.

products.name: Custom Wood Furniture
products.description: Custom bedroom and dining furniture assembled and finished in the Martinsville, Virginia factory, using a mix of domestic and globally sourced components, tailored to customer orders.

products.name: Casegoods (Formal Bedroom and Dining Room Furniture)
products.description: Includes formal bedroom and dining room furniture, primarily sourced as fully finished products from foreign plants, especially in Vietnam, and distributed through retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Outdoor Furniture
products.description: Outdoor furniture offerings, including products under the Lane Venture brand, manufactured in company facilities (including aluminum frame production in Alabama) and distributed through wholesale and retail channels.

products.name: Home Accessories and Mattresses
products.description: A range of home accessories, bedding, and mattresses, including non-Bassett-branded products, sold primarily through retail stores and online. These are sourced and resold rather than manufactured in-house.

products.name: Furniture Protection Plans
products.description: Service plans for furniture protection, sold alongside furniture and accessory products in retail stores and online, providing customers with coverage for accidental damage.

products.name: In-Home and Virtual Design Services
products.description: Professional design consulting services, including free in-home or virtual visits, provided by trained Design Consultants to assist customers with home makeovers and decor solutions.

products.name: E-Commerce Furniture Sales
products.description: Online sales of furniture and accessories through the company’s website, leveraging a digital platform for customer research, engagement, and direct purchasing, with fulfillment from company inventory.

products.name: Fire Retardants
products.description: Chemically formulated products manufactured in dedicated facilities and applied via aircraft or ground equipment to slow, stop, and prevent wildfires and other fires. Delivered to government and commercial customers, often as part of a bundled solution with equipment and services.

products.name: Fire Suppressants (Firefighting Foams)
products.description: Manufactured Class B, Class A, Class A/B, and training firefighting foams, including fluorine-free formulations, used to suppress flammable liquid and structural fires. Delivered to industrial, aviation, military, and municipal customers, often with custom equipment and support services.

products.name: Firefighting Equipment and Operational Services
products.description: Design, manufacture, installation, and operation of specialized air base and foam delivery equipment, including storage, mixing, proportioning, and ground application units, as well as management and staffing of air base operations. Delivered as standalone or bundled with fire retardants and foams.

products.name: Lubricant Additives (Phosphorus Pentasulfide-based)
products.description: Production of phosphorus pentasulfide (P2S5) based chemical additives for lubricants, manufactured in specialized chemical facilities and supplied to global lubricant producers. Also used in pesticides, mining chemicals, and emerging battery technologies.

products.name: Electronic and Electromechanical Components
products.description: Manufacture of electronic and electromechanical components, including vertically integrated production for communications, energy, defense, and industrial systems, with a focus on aftermarket repair and replacement. Delivered to OEMs and system integrators globally.

products.name: Medical Device Manufacturing Machinery and Aftermarket Consumables
products.description: Design, manufacture, and global supply of highly engineered machinery, automation solutions, and recurring aftermarket parts, consumables, and services for the production of complex medical devices and select industrial/aerospace applications. Delivered to regulated medical device manufacturers worldwide.

products.name: NeXT Personal Dx
products.description: A tumor-informed liquid biopsy test for detection of minimal residual disease (MRD) and recurrence monitoring in solid tumor cancer patients, involving whole genome sequencing of matched tumor and normal samples to create a personalized detection assay, performed in a CLIA-certified laboratory and delivered as a clinical testing service to physicians and patients.

products.name: NeXT Dx
products.description: A comprehensive tumor profiling test for therapy selection and clinical trial identification in cancer patients, utilizing exome and transcriptome sequencing with matched tumor-normal analysis, performed in a CLIA-certified laboratory and delivered as a clinical testing service to physicians.

products.name: NeXT Personal
products.description: A tumor-informed liquid biopsy test for detection of MRD and recurrence monitoring in solid tumor cancers, designed for pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical companies for use in clinical trials, patient selection, and as a potential companion diagnostic, performed in a CLIA-certified laboratory and delivered as a testing service.

products.name: ImmunoID NeXT
products.description: A tissue-based test combining whole exome and transcriptome sequencing with advanced analytics to provide a multi-dimensional view of the tumor and microenvironment, enabling biomarker discovery and immunotherapy research for pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical companies, delivered as a laboratory testing service.

products.name: Whole Exome Sequencing (WES) Services
products.description: Whole exome sequencing of cancer tissue and matched blood samples performed for diagnostic companies as an input to their products, delivered as a laboratory service using high-throughput sequencing platforms.

products.name: Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS) Services
products.description: Whole genome sequencing of human samples for research projects, such as population sequencing initiatives, delivered as a laboratory service using high-throughput sequencing platforms.

products.name: Papzimeos (zopapogene imadenovec-drba, PRGN-2012)
products.description: An FDA-approved, non-replicating adenoviral vector-based immunotherapy for adults with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP), manufactured using proprietary gorilla adenovector technology and delivered via subcutaneous injection.

products.name: AdenoVerse Immunotherapy Platform Therapies
products.description: A suite of precision immunotherapies based on proprietary adenovector technology, designed for off-the-shelf delivery to activate immune responses against specific disease targets, manufactured using scalable cell lines and cGMP facilities.

products.name: UltraCAR-T Cell Therapies
products.description: Personalized, autologous CAR-T cell therapies manufactured using a rapid, decentralized, non-viral process at medical centers, targeting various tumor antigens for hematological and solid cancers, enabled by proprietary UltraCAR-T and UltraPorator technologies.

products.name: Porcine Research Models and Services (Exemplar MiniSwine)
products.description: Genetically engineered Yucatan MiniSwine research models and related services, produced in specialized facilities, sold to industry and academic clients for preclinical testing of human disease mechanisms and therapeutics.

products.name: Allogeneic CAR T Cell Therapies for Hematologic Malignancies
products.description: Genetically engineered, off-the-shelf T cell therapies derived from healthy donors, manufactured using proprietary gene-editing and cell processing technologies, designed to target antigens such as CD19 for the treatment of blood cancers like large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL) and other B-cell leukemias and lymphomas. Delivered as a cryopreserved cell product to treatment centers for patient infusion.

products.name: Allogeneic CAR T Cell Therapies for Solid Tumors
products.description: Engineered, off-the-shelf T cell therapies targeting antigens such as CD70, manufactured from healthy donor cells using advanced gene-editing and cell expansion processes, for the treatment of solid tumors including clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC). Product is cryopreserved and shipped to clinical sites for patient administration.

products.name: Allogeneic CAR T Cell Therapies for Autoimmune Diseases
products.description: Off-the-shelf, gene-edited T cell therapies targeting both CD19 and CD70, produced from healthy donors using proprietary gene-editing and manufacturing technologies, intended to eliminate pathogenic immune cells in autoimmune diseases such as systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), idiopathic inflammatory myopathies (IIM), and systemic sclerosis (SSc). Delivered as a cryopreserved cell product for infusion.

products.name: Allogeneic CAR T Cell Therapies for Other Oncology Indications (Pipeline)
products.description: Research-stage, off-the-shelf CAR T cell therapies targeting additional antigens such as BCMA, FLT3, DLL3, and Claudin 18.2, manufactured using proprietary gene-editing and cell processing technologies, for the treatment of cancers including multiple myeloma, acute myeloid leukemia, small cell lung cancer, and gastric/pancreatic cancer. These are in earlier stages of development and not current commercial focus.

products.name: CrowdStrike Falcon Platform
products.description: A unified, cloud-native cybersecurity platform delivered via SaaS subscription, integrating a single lightweight sensor and multiple cloud modules to provide protection, detection, investigation, and response across endpoints, cloud workloads, identities, and data. Delivered digitally and requires no on-premise hardware.

products.name: Endpoint Security Solutions
products.description: Next-generation antivirus, endpoint detection and response (EDR), and extended detection and response (XDR) delivered through the Falcon platform to protect endpoints from malware, fileless attacks, and advanced threats. Requires deployment of a lightweight sensor on endpoints and is managed via the cloud.

products.name: Cloud Security Solutions
products.description: Cloud-native security solutions to protect cloud workloads, containers, and applications in real time, including runtime protection, cloud security posture management, and application security posture management. Delivered as SaaS and integrates into developer workflows for multi-cloud environments.

products.name: Identity Protection Solutions
products.description: Real-time detection, behavioral analytics, and policy enforcement to safeguard against identity-based attacks, providing visibility into anomalies and lateral movement. Delivered as a cloud module and integrated with the Falcon platform.

products.name: Data Protection Solutions
products.description: Solutions to prevent data theft by monitoring and controlling sensitive data movement across endpoints, web applications, cloud drives, and USB storage devices. Delivered as a cloud module, leveraging content and context for real-time visibility and enforcement.

products.name: Next-Generation SIEM and Log Management
products.description: AI-driven security information and event management (SIEM) and log management solutions that provide detection, data pipelining, centralized case management, and investigation capabilities for any data source. Delivered as a cloud module integrated with the Falcon platform.

products.name: Exposure Management Solutions
products.description: Unified solutions for IT hygiene, vulnerability management, and external attack surface management, enabling organizations to predict attack paths, prioritize remediation, and proactively reduce risk. Delivered as a cloud module within the Falcon platform.

products.name: Managed Detection and Response (MDR) Services
products.description: Comprehensive managed security services combining 24/7 expert monitoring, investigation, response, and remediation across the attack lifecycle, delivered by CrowdStrike’s security experts and powered by the Falcon platform. Provided as a subscription service.

products.name: Threat Intelligence and Counter Adversary Operations
products.description: Proactive threat hunting, intelligence, and adversary operations services leveraging elite security experts and proprietary graph technologies to identify and mitigate advanced threats. Delivered as a cloud module and service.

products.name: IT Automation and Operations Management
products.description: Cloud-delivered solutions for IT operations management, asset visibility, and automation, enabling rapid resolution of issues and streamlined IT processes through generative AI workflows. Delivered as a module within the Falcon platform.

products.name: SaaS Security Posture Management
products.description: Continuous monitoring and proactive risk mitigation for business-critical SaaS applications, providing context and visibility into risks from users, devices, and non-human identities. Delivered as a cloud module (including Adaptive Shield) integrated with the Falcon platform.

products.name: Generative AI Security and Automation
products.description: AI-powered workflow automation and security for generative AI and AI-driven systems, including AI Detection and Response (AIDR), policy enforcement, and protection against AI-specific threats. Delivered as cloud modules such as Charlotte AI and AIDR.

products.name: Incident Response, Forensics, and Recovery Services
products.description: Professional services for incident response, forensic investigation, and breach recovery, including deployment of Falcon sensors, customized recovery, and remediation. Delivered by expert teams as a service engagement.

products.name: Security Consulting and Advisory Services
products.description: Technical assessment, strategic advisory, compromise assessments, cybersecurity maturity assessments, and red-teaming services to help organizations understand and improve their security posture. Delivered as professional consulting engagements.

products.name: Training and Certification Services
products.description: Training and certification programs on CrowdStrike technologies and cybersecurity topics, delivered via online learning, instructor-led courses, and proctored exams. Offered to customers and partners as a subscription or service.

products.name: Cementing Services
products.description: Blending and deploying customized cement slurries to secure production casing in oil and gas wells, using specialized laboratory facilities and twin-pumping units. This service requires physical manufacturing, technical expertise, and in-person labor at wellsites.

products.name: Completion Tools
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of proprietary downhole tools and technologies for multistage well completions, including composite, hybrid, and dissolvable frac plugs, liner hangers, packers, sleeves, and other patented tools. These are physical products delivered to customers for use in well completion operations.

products.name: Wireline Services
products.description: Provision of wireline and electric wireline operations for well completion, intervention, and pipe recovery, using a fleet of specialized wireline units and proprietary tools. This service is delivered on-site by skilled crews and advanced equipment.

products.name: Coiled Tubing Services
products.description: Wellbore intervention operations using continuous steel pipe (coiled tubing) for tasks such as milling, drilling, fishing, production logging, artificial lift, cementing, and stimulation. Delivered with specialized equipment and crews at the wellsite, including data acquisition technology.

products.name: Upscale Casual Dining Restaurants (The Cheesecake Factory)
products.description: Full-service, upscale casual dining restaurants offering an extensive, innovative menu and premium desserts, with both on-premise and off-premise (takeout and delivery) options. Requires physical restaurant operations, trained staff, and regulated food and beverage service.

products.name: Bakery Products (Cheesecakes and Baked Goods)
products.description: Production and sale of proprietary cheesecakes and other baked desserts through company restaurants, international licensees, and third-party foodservice, retail, and distributor customers. Requires physical manufacturing in company-owned bakery facilities and distribution to various channels.

products.name: Italian Casual Dining Restaurants (North Italia)
products.description: Full-service, upscale casual dining restaurants specializing in modern Italian cuisine made from scratch daily, offering dine-in and off-premise (takeout and delivery) options. Requires physical restaurant operations and trained staff.

products.name: Fast Casual Healthy Dining Restaurants (Flower Child)
products.description: Fast casual restaurants offering customizable, made-from-scratch menus with locally-sourced, all-natural and organic ingredients, available for dine-in and off-premise consumption. Requires physical restaurant operations and supply chain for fresh ingredients.

products.name: Other Specialty Restaurant Concepts (Fox Restaurant Concepts/FRC)
products.description: A portfolio of diverse restaurant brands (e.g., Culinary Dropout, The Henry, Blanco) offering various dining experiences across segments and cuisines, operated as an incubator for new concepts. Requires physical restaurant operations and brand development.

products.name: International Licensed Restaurants (The Cheesecake Factory)
products.description: Licensing of The Cheesecake Factory brand and restaurant concept to third-party operators in international markets, generating revenue from development fees, royalties, and bakery product sales. Involves brand oversight, training, and supply of bakery goods.

products.name: Consumer Packaged Goods (The Cheesecake Factory At Home)
products.description: Branded consumer packaged goods, such as Famous 'Brown Bread' and other products, produced through third-party manufacturers and sold in retail stores and internationally. Involves brand licensing and supply chain partnerships.

products.name: Cybersecurity Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive software-based solutions providing real-time threat protection for PCs, Macs, and mobile devices against malware, viruses, ransomware, and other online threats. Delivered digitally via direct-to-consumer and partner channels, including AI-powered scam protection and device performance optimization.

products.name: Identity Protection Services
products.description: Subscription-based services that monitor credit, dark web, social media, and financial accounts to detect and respond to identity theft, including restoration support and insurance. Delivered digitally through brands like LifeLock, Norton, Avast, and AVG.

products.name: Online Privacy Solutions
products.description: Digital privacy products including VPNs, anti-tracking tools, secure browsers, and data removal services that protect user data and anonymity online. Delivered as software and services under brands such as Norton, Avast, and AVG.

products.name: Comprehensive Cyber Safety Memberships
products.description: All-in-one subscription plans (e.g., Norton 360, Avast One) bundling security, identity, and privacy solutions with multiple membership tiers. Delivered digitally, these plans provide integrated protection across devices and platforms for individuals and families.

products.name: Digital Reputation Management Services
products.description: White glove services (e.g., ReputationDefender) that help customers manage and improve their online presence, including search results and social media profiles. Delivered as a managed service.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive wealth management for ultra-high-net-worth individuals, families, foundations, and institutions, including discretionary and non-discretionary investment management, estate and wealth planning, trust and fiduciary services, governance, education, philanthropy, and family office services. Delivered through a combination of in-person advisory, digital reporting, and tailored administrative support.

products.name: Alternative Investment Solutions Platform
products.description: Access to alternative investment opportunities, including private equity, private credit, hedge funds, real estate, infrastructure, and other hard-to-access asset classes, delivered via proprietary vehicles and partnerships with third-party managers. Includes both traditional and impact investing strategies, with recurring launches of new private market vehicles.

products.name: Internally Managed Event-Driven Fund (TIG Arbitrage)
products.description: Management of an event-driven global merger arbitrage fund, focusing on short-term merger events and complex situations, delivered through a dedicated investment team and proprietary research. Managed by a registered investment advisor subsidiary.

products.name: External Alternatives Fund Management (Strategic Manager Stakes)
products.description: Equity stakes and revenue sharing in externally managed funds specializing in real estate bridge lending, European equities, and Asian credit/special situations. AlTi provides capital and receives a share of management and incentive fees, supporting the growth of these managers’ fund businesses.

products.name: Trust and Fiduciary Services
products.description: Creation and administration of trust instruments, acting as fiduciary in various capacities, primarily delivered from Delaware under established legal regimes. Services include trust structuring, modification, and ongoing administration for wealth preservation and distribution.

products.name: Family Office Services
products.description: Outsourced family office solutions and administrative services for large clients, including bookkeeping, back office, private foundation management, trust administration oversight, financial tracking, cash flow management, bill pay, and other financial services. Delivered through dedicated teams and tailored processes.

products.name: Impact Investing Solutions
products.description: Impact and values-based investment strategies offered across asset classes, including both traditional and alternative investments, designed to align with clients’ social and environmental objectives. Delivered through proprietary vehicles and manager selection.

products.name: Ancillary Fund Management Services for External Managers
products.description: Sales and marketing solutions, centralized marketing, investor relations, materials oversight, and branding services provided to external fund managers in which AlTi has strategic investments. Previously included back and middle office solutions, now spun out as a separate entity.

products.name: DNA Medicines for HPV-Associated Diseases
products.description: Therapeutic DNA medicines designed to treat and protect against diseases caused by human papillomavirus (HPV), including recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP), cervical high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions (HSIL), and anal/perianal HSIL. These products are manufactured using proprietary DNA plasmid technology and delivered via electroporation devices.

products.name: DNA Medicines for Cancer Immunotherapy
products.description: DNA-based immunotherapies targeting various cancers, including oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC), glioblastoma multiforme (GBM), and cancers associated with BRCA1/2 mutations. These therapies use DNA plasmids encoding tumor-associated antigens and immune activators, delivered with proprietary electroporation devices.

products.name: DNA Medicines for Infectious Diseases
products.description: DNA-based vaccines and immunotherapies for infectious diseases such as COVID-19, Ebola virus, and HIV. These products are developed using proprietary DNA plasmid technology and delivered via electroporation devices, enabling in vivo protein production for immune response.

products.name: DNA-Encoded Monoclonal Antibody (DMAb) Therapies
products.description: DNA plasmid-based therapies encoding monoclonal antibodies for in vivo production by the patient's own cells, targeting infectious diseases and other conditions. Delivered via electroporation devices, these therapies aim for sustained antibody production and lower manufacturing costs compared to traditional mAbs.

products.name: DNA-Encoded Protein Replacement Therapies (DPROT)
products.description: Preclinical DNA-encoded protein therapies designed to enable long-term in vivo expression of therapeutic proteins for protein replacement, such as for hemophilia A. These are delivered via electroporation and aim to overcome limitations of conventional protein replacement and gene therapy.

products.name: Electroporation Delivery Devices (CELLECTRA)
products.description: Proprietary electroporation devices (CELLECTRA) designed to deliver DNA medicines into cells by creating temporary pores in cell membranes. Devices are manufactured under cGMP and are used in conjunction with DNA medicine candidates for optimal delivery and efficacy.

products.name: NXP900 Oncology Therapeutic
products.description: A targeted, small molecule drug candidate that inhibits SRC and YES1 kinases, developed for the treatment of solid tumor cancers. It is produced through pharmaceutical R&D, licensed from the University of Edinburgh, and manufactured by third-party cGMP facilities for clinical trials and potential commercialization.

products.name: NXP800 Oncology Therapeutic
products.description: A small molecule product candidate intended for the treatment of a broad range of cancers. Developed through pharmaceutical R&D and licensed from CRT Pioneer Fund, though clinical development was ceased after Phase 1b in July 2025.

products.name: Program Services (Fronting Services)
products.description: Kestrel Group provides fronting services and issuing carrier capacity to insurance program managers, MGAs, reinsurers, and reinsurance brokers, facilitating access to the U.S. property and casualty insurance market. This is a fee-based service leveraging exclusive management contracts with highly rated insurance carriers, and includes compliance, regulatory reporting, and administrative support culminating in the placement of bound insurance coverage. The company generally does not assume underwriting risk, instead relying on partners for policy administration and claims handling.

products.name: Legacy Reinsurance
products.description: This segment consists of run-off reinsurance portfolios previously produced by Maiden, including both AmTrust Reinsurance Legacy Business and Diversified Reinsurance Legacy Business. It involves managing and running off existing reinsurance liabilities, including property and casualty reinsurance for regional and specialty insurers, as well as quota share and excess of loss treaties, primarily in Europe and the U.S. No new business is being written; the focus is on managing existing obligations and finality solutions.

products.name: Income Protection Insurance (Scandinavia and Northern Europe)
products.description: Through Maiden LF and Maiden GF, the company historically wrote short-term income protection insurance on a primary basis in Scandinavian and Northern European markets. These operations are in run-off and not writing new business, but the management of these portfolios continues until final disposition or sale.

products.name: Branded Auto and Credit Life Insurance (International Insurance Services)
products.description: Previously, through Maiden Global, the company provided branded auto and credit life insurance products via insurer partners, particularly in Europe and other global markets. These products also produced reinsurance programs underwritten by Maiden Reinsurance. This business is in run-off and not writing new business.

products.name: MoDE and TRAP Degrader Therapeutics
products.description: A portfolio of bispecific molecular degraders (MoDE and TRAP) that selectively target and remove disease-causing extracellular proteins, such as pathogenic immunoglobulins, via liver-mediated degradation. Delivered as proprietary subcutaneous formulations, often with autoinjectors for patient self-administration. Requires advanced biologics manufacturing and regulated clinical development.

products.name: Kv7 Ion Channel Modulator Therapeutics (Opakalim and related compounds)
products.description: Small molecule drugs that activate Kv7.2/7.3 potassium channels to treat neurological and neuropsychiatric disorders such as epilepsy, major depressive disorder, bipolar disorder, and neuropathic pain. Developed as oral formulations, including extended-release, requiring chemical synthesis and clinical trials.

products.name: Myostatin-Activin Pathway Inhibitor Therapeutics (Taldefgrobep Alfa)
products.description: Biologic therapies targeting the myostatin-activin pathway to increase muscle mass and reduce adiposity, for neuromuscular diseases (e.g., spinal muscular atrophy, Duchenne muscular dystrophy) and metabolic disorders (e.g., obesity). Delivered as subcutaneous injections, requiring biologics manufacturing and clinical development.

products.name: Glutamate Modulation Therapeutics (Troriluzole and related compounds)
products.description: Small molecule drugs that modulate glutamate neurotransmission, including prodrugs of riluzole, for neurological and neuropsychiatric diseases such as spinocerebellar ataxia, obsessive-compulsive disorder, and glioblastoma. Developed as oral formulations, requiring chemical synthesis and clinical trials.

products.name: TRPM3 Ion Channel Antagonist Therapeutics (BHV-2100 and related compounds)
products.description: Orally bioavailable small molecule antagonists of the TRPM3 ion channel, developed for the treatment of neuropathic pain and migraine. Requires chemical synthesis, preclinical and clinical development.

products.name: TYK2/JAK1 Dual Inhibitor Therapeutics (BHV-8000)
products.description: Small molecule, brain-penetrant dual inhibitors of TYK2 and JAK1 kinases for neuroinflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases such as Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, and multiple sclerosis. Requires chemical synthesis and clinical development.

products.name: Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADCs) for Oncology (BHV-1510, BHV-1530, BHV-1500)
products.description: Next-generation antibody drug conjugates (ADCs) targeting cancer antigens (e.g., TROP-2, FGFR3, CD30) for the treatment of solid tumors and lymphomas. These biologic drugs are manufactured using proprietary conjugation technologies and require regulated clinical development.

products.name: Bitcoin Mining Services
products.description: Operation of large-scale, energy-efficient data centers to mine bitcoin using specialized hardware. The company manages and allocates energy to maximize mining efficiency and profitability, with both owned and hosted sites across multiple continents.

products.name: AI Inference and High-Performance Computing (HPC) Infrastructure Services
products.description: Provision of compute capacity and private, dedicated cloud solutions for AI inference and HPC workloads, leveraging owned and operated data centers and energy infrastructure. Services are delivered to third-party customers, with offerings including secure cloud and AI infrastructure.

products.name: Digital Asset Management and Bitcoin-Related Financial Services
products.description: Management and monetization of bitcoin holdings through lending arrangements, structured trading strategies, collateralized financing, and other bitcoin-denominated transactions to generate incremental income and support operations.

products.name: Pharmaceutical Drug Delivery Systems
products.description: Manufactured drug delivery devices such as nasal spray pumps, metered dose inhaler valves, unidose and biodose devices, and accessories for prescription and over-the-counter medications. These products are produced in regulated, clean-room environments and require significant research, engineering, and compliance with pharmaceutical regulations.

products.name: Elastomeric Primary Packaging Components for Injectables
products.description: Manufactures elastomeric components such as stoppers for vials, pre-filled syringe plungers, needle shields, tip caps, and cartridge components used in injectable drug delivery. Production involves specialized elastomer and silicone formulation and finishing, often in clean-room environments.

products.name: Active Material Science Solutions
products.description: Develops and manufactures polymer-based active packaging solutions that protect pharmaceuticals, medical devices, diagnostics, and selected food products by absorbing moisture, scavenging oxygen, or emitting aromas. These are engineered using proprietary material science technologies.

products.name: Digital Health Solutions
products.description: Provides regulated software, connected devices, and digital therapeutic tools to support patient treatment adherence, disease management, and remote monitoring. These solutions are available standalone or integrated with drug delivery devices and are developed using digital and analytical expertise.

products.name: Dispensing Pumps and Systems for Beauty and Personal Care
products.description: Designs and manufactures finger-actuated dispensing pumps, airless systems, and spray pumps for fragrance, facial skincare, color cosmetics, and personal care products. Production involves high-speed assembly and plastic injection molding to meet functional and aesthetic requirements.

products.name: Aerosol Valves and Continuous Spray Systems
products.description: Manufactures aerosol valves and continuous spray systems for pharmaceutical, personal care, home care, and industrial applications. These products are assembled from plastic, metal, and rubber components using high-speed equipment and are used in pressurized containers.

products.name: Dispensing Closures for Food, Beverage, and Consumer Products
products.description: Produces dispensing and non-dispensing closures for food, beverage, personal care, home care, and beauty products. These closures are manufactured using advanced plastic injection molding and may include features like flow-control, no-drip, tethered caps, and sustainability enhancements.

products.name: Food Service Trays and Packaging Solutions
products.description: Manufactures absorbent and non-absorbent food service trays and packaging solutions, leveraging material science technology to enhance shelf life. These products are produced using plastic molding and material science expertise for the food service industry.

products.name: Revita Duodenal Mucosal Resurfacing (DMR) System
products.description: A minimally invasive, outpatient endoscopic procedural therapy that uses a proprietary balloon catheter and console to hydrothermally ablate the duodenal mucosa, enabling regeneration and renewal of the duodenum to restore metabolic signaling. Manufactured as a medical device system, it is delivered by trained endoscopists in clinical settings.

products.name: Rejuva Pancreatic Gene Therapy Platform
products.description: A modular, endoscopically administered gene therapy platform using adeno-associated virus (AAV) vectors to deliver metabolically active genes directly to the pancreas, aiming to reprogram islet cells for endogenous hormone production. Delivered via a proprietary catheter in a single outpatient endoscopic procedure, it is designed for long-term remission of type 2 diabetes and obesity.
